_comment: Klondike Solitaire locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. NEVER translate card labels/suits (e.g. A, 10, K, ♣️, ♦️, ♥️, ♠️), the pile tokens W, F1-F4, T1-T7, the ASCII board in {board}, or the commands 'draw', 'move', 'forfeit', 'all'. The bracket syntax like 'move W T1' must stay in Latin as-is.

_slots.{n}: Action index within a comma-separated command, 1-based
_slots.{msg}: A nested per-action result message (already localized)
_slots.{count}: Number of face-up cards being moved
_slots.{cmd}: The unknown command the player typed (not translated)
_slots.{max_turns}: The maximum number of turns before the game ends
_slots.{score}: Number of cards currently in the foundation piles
_slots.{stock}: Number of cards left in the stock
_slots.{waste}: The top waste card label, or '--' if empty (never translate)
_slots.{cards}: The cards in a pile as neutral labels, or '--' if empty (never translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Ũrangĩra Klondike Solitaire. Irĩo yako ni kuhamisha karata zote kwenye mirundo ya msingi.

Sheria za Mchezo:
- Mirundo ya msingi (F1-F4): Jenga kutoka Ace hadi King kwa rangi
- Mirundo ya meza (T1-T7): Jenga chini kwa rangi zinazobadilika (nyekundu juu ya nyeusi, nyeusi juu ya nyekundu)
- Hifadhi: Chora karata kwenye mirundo ya taka
- Taka (W): Karata ya juu inapatikana kwa mchezo

Maagizo:
- 'draw' - Chora karata kutoka kwa hifadhi hadi taka
- 'move <source> <destination> [count]' - Hamisha karata kati ya mirundo
  Mifano: 'move W T1', 'move T1 F2', 'move T3 T5 2'. idadi pia inaweza kuwa 'all', ambayo itajaribu kuhamisha karata zote zilizo wazi.
- 'forfeit' - Maliza mchezo mara moja na uweke alama yako ya sasa
- Majina ya mirundo: W (taka), F1-F4 (msingi), T1-T7 (meza)

Unaweza kutekeleza vitendo vingi katika zamu moja kwa kuzitenganisha na alama za makoma:
  Mfano: 'draw, move W T1, move T2 F1'

Wafalme pekee wanaweza kuwekwa kwenye mirundo tupu ya meza.
Vitendo vinafanywa kwa mpangilio - ikiwa kimoja kinafeli, vitendo vilivyobaki vinapuuzwa.
Tumia 'forfeit' ikiwa unaamini kuwa mchezo hauwezekani kushinda.

format_error.no_brackets: Njĩra ya kũruta wĩra ndĩagĩrĩire. Ĩngĩoneka na ndemwa cia kĩrũgamo.
format_error.no_closing_bracket: Mũbango wa kĩama ũtarĩ mwega. Kũrema gatembe ga kũhingĩrĩria ']'
format_error.move_needs_args: Amri ya kusogeza inahitaji chanzo na lengo. Matumizi: 'move <source> <destination> [count]'
format_error.count_invalid: Idadi isiyo sahihi. Tumia nambari au 'all'

move_result.drew: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio, nĩ aambĩrĩirie kũhũthĩra kaarĩhi kau.
move_result.cannot_draw: Tũtingĩhota kũruta indo, tũhũ na iria ingĩ itarĩ nacio.
move_result.invalid_pile: Rĩĩtwa rĩtarĩ rĩa kĩguni. Thiĩ na W, F1-F4, kana T1-T7
move_result.foundation_one_card: No kũhota gũtwara kandi ĩmwe tu mũthingi-inĩ.
move_result.waste_to_foundation_ok: Karatathi ga gũthamĩrio kuuma gĩko-inĩ nginya mũthingi F{dst}
move_result.waste_to_foundation_bad: Ndũngĩhota gũtwara kaadi ya kũhũrwo harĩ mũthingi ũcio wa kabati ĩyo.
move_result.tableau_to_foundation_ok: Ilifanya kadi kutoka tableau T{src} hadi foundation F{dst}
move_result.tableau_to_foundation_bad: Ndũngĩhota gũtwara kandi ya kĩbungo gĩaku harĩ mũthingi ũcio wa kabuku kau.
move_result.foundation_to_foundation: Ndũngĩhota gũthiĩ kuuma mũthingi ũmwe nginya ũrĩa ũngĩ.
move_result.waste_to_tableau_one_card: No ĩhote gũthamia o kaarti kamwe tu kuuma gĩkoinĩ kĩa mathaga nginya mũcoro-inĩ wa karati.
move_result.waste_to_tableau_ok: Kadi imehamishwa kutoka kwa taka hadi jedwali T{dst}
move_result.waste_to_tableau_bad: Ndũngĩiga karati ya kũhũrwo kĩronda-inĩ kĩu kĩa tableau
move_result.no_face_up: Gũtirĩ kaarĩ ga kũguucĩrĩrio karĩa gakũgarũrũkaga.
move_result.tableau_to_tableau_ok: Ilifanya {count} kadi(s) kutoka tableau T{src} hadi T{dst}
move_result.tableau_to_tableau_bad: Haiwezi kusogea {count} kadi(s) kutoka T{src} hadi T{dst}
move_result.foundation_to_tableau_one_card: No ĩhote gũthamia kadi ĩmwe tu kuuma mũthingi nginya gĩtarainĩ kĩa mbere.
move_result.foundation_to_tableau_ok: Ilifanya kadi kutoka foundation F{src} hadi tableau T{dst}
move_result.foundation_to_tableau_bad: Ndũngĩhota kũiga kaarĩki ya mũthingi gĩtara-inĩ T{dst}
move_result.to_waste_or_stock: Ndũngĩhota gũtwarwo gĩkoinĩ kĩa mĩtarakwa kana indo iria irĩ kuo.
